scientific_integrity: All field arithmetic and target enumeration are reproducible; finite computation is not used as a proof for unbounded field orders. The known zero-target square fiber is excluded from the novel contribution.
scientific_limitations: Only the unweighted four-clique evolution algebra and the single square map are classified.
Characteristic-three saturation is relative to the three-dimensional linear square, not the entire algebra.
All missing-target counts at fields of order at most 243 are certified by exhaustive finite computation; larger fields are handled by a classical character-sum estimate.
The exact distribution of every nonzero target fiber is not separately tabulated.
Historical priority relative to unlocated Paley-incidence literature requires independent investigation.
title: A sharp \(3^5\) square-image saturation threshold in the four-clique evolution algebra
